summary.fr: Fatehold : scry et surveil déclenchent Prudent Fateseer et Desperate Futurescribe, les jetons Cadet et le Jace token d'empower Jace complètent le board. Les deux en étaient les signposts.
summary.en: Fatehold: scry and surveil trigger Prudent Fateseer and Desperate Futurescribe, while Cadet tokens and the empower Jace token fill out the board. Both were the signposts.

fr: Le meilleur taux de victoire du set.
Fatehold Chronologist, Hexhaven Battalion et Campus Crier : des communes qui créent jetons et Jace.
Surgical Precision et Memory Trap donnaient au blanc un removal efficace.
en: The best win rate of the set.
Fatehold Chronologist, Hexhaven Battalion and Campus Crier were commons that made tokens and Jace.
Surgical Precision and Memory Trap gave white efficient removal.

summary.fr: Theorix : mill et threshold (sept cartes au cimetière) pour Theorix Metamage et Proft, Sinister Mastermind, Recursive Recruitment rejouée en flashback. Paradox Shaper et Recursive Recruitment en étaient les signposts.
summary.en: Theorix: mill and threshold (seven cards in the graveyard) for Theorix Metamage and Proft, Sinister Mastermind, with Recursive Recruitment recast by flashback. Paradox Shaper and Recursive Recruitment were the signposts.

fr: La paire la plus jouée du set et son deuxième meilleur taux de victoire.
Extended Absence, Last Gasp et Icy Reception : du removal et des counters en commune.
Mindseeker Oculus et Recursive Recruitment figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: The most-played pair of the set and its second-best win rate.
Extended Absence, Last Gasp and Icy Reception gave removal and counters at common.
Mindseeker Oculus and Recursive Recruitment were among its best-performing cards.

summary.fr: Konstrari : les jetons Heartwood (artefacts qui produisent du mana) accélèrent vers Craftwork Crusher et les gros sorts rouges. Heartwood Crafter et Woodwork Prodigy en étaient les signposts.
summary.en: Konstrari: Heartwood tokens (mana-producing artifacts) ramp into Craftwork Crusher and the big red spells. Heartwood Crafter and Woodwork Prodigy were the signposts.

fr: Au-dessus de la moyenne du set, juste derrière Azorius et Dimir.
Konstrari Improviser, commune multicolore, donnait le Heartwood dès le deuxième tour.
Craftwork Crusher et Violent Echoes figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: Above the set average, just behind Azorius and Dimir.
Konstrari Improviser, a gold common, provided the Heartwood from the early turns.
Craftwork Crusher and Violent Echoes were among its best-performing cards.

summary.fr: Dimir et Golgari réunis : Primal Witchstalker et le mill nourrissent Hapatra, Recursive Recruitment et Mind Meanderer, les terrains Annex et Commons fixent le mana.
summary.en: Dimir and Golgari combined: Primal Witchstalker and mill feed Hapatra, Recursive Recruitment and Mind Meanderer, while the Annex and Commons lands fix the mana.

fr: La seule combinaison tricolore assez jouée, au-dessus de la moyenne du set.
Les terrains bicolores entraient dégagés avec un planeswalker, ce qui facilitait trois couleurs.
Recursive Recruitment figurait parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: The only three-color combination played enough, above the set average.
The dual lands entered untapped with a planeswalker out, easing three colors.
Recursive Recruitment was among its best-performing cards.

summary.fr: Sorts non-créature : Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar crée un Thopter à chaque sort, Twinned Vision se rejoue en flashback, Clash of Elements gère le board.
summary.en: Noncreature spells: Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar makes a Thopter with each one, Twinned Vision is recast with flashback, and Clash of Elements handles the board.

fr: Au-dessus de la moyenne du set.
No Admittance et Wrath of the Bloodmane : le removal rouge commun.
Twinned Vision et Clash of Elements figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: Above the set average.
No Admittance and Wrath of the Bloodmane were its common red removal.
Twinned Vision and Clash of Elements were among its best-performing cards.

summary.fr: Mill et grosses cartes au cimetière : Primal Witchstalker meule et rend un terrain, Hapatra, the Desert Fang pose des marqueurs -1/-1 selon le plus gros coût du cimetière.
summary.en: Mill and big cards in the graveyard: Primal Witchstalker mills and returns a land, and Hapatra, the Desert Fang places -1/-1 counters based on the graveyard's highest mana value.

fr: Juste au-dessus de la moyenne du set.
Hapatra, the Desert Fang, joué dans la majorité des decks, servait de removal.
Extended Absence et Last Gasp complétaient le removal noir commun.
en: Just above the set average.
Hapatra, the Desert Fang, in most of its decks, doubled as removal.
Extended Absence and Last Gasp rounded out the common black removal.

summary.fr: Stingerquill : les dégâts non-combat à l'adversaire activent Grim Repriser et Whiplash Wordsmith, Stingerquill Voxmancer inflige un point à chaque entretien.
summary.en: Stingerquill: noncombat damage to the opponent switches on Grim Repriser and Whiplash Wordsmith, while Stingerquill Voxmancer pings each upkeep.

fr: Sous la moyenne du set.
Stingerquill Charm et No Admittance : du burn souple en commune et uncommon.
Kiora of Fire and Ashes et Break Under Pressure figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: Below the set average.
Stingerquill Charm and No Admittance were flexible burn at common and uncommon.
Kiora of Fire and Ashes and Break Under Pressure were among its best-performing cards.

summary.fr: Vigorbloom : gain de vie et marqueurs +1/+1. Greenhouse Propagator et Blossom-Blessed Angel font gagner de la vie, Unflinching Hortimancer grandit, Bloombrute pioche.
summary.en: Vigorbloom: life gain and +1/+1 counters. Greenhouse Propagator and Blossom-Blessed Angel gain life, Unflinching Hortimancer grows, and Bloombrute draws.

fr: Sous la moyenne du set malgré un bon volume de parties.
Surgical Precision et Memory Trap : le removal blanc, partagé avec Azorius.
Vigorbloom Charm et Medic's Kitesail figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: Below the set average despite a good volume of games.
Surgical Precision and Memory Trap were its removal, shared with Azorius.
Vigorbloom Charm and Medic's Kitesail were among its best-performing cards.

summary.fr: Créatures qui entrent et marqueurs +1/+1 : Mabel, Valley Hero en place un sur chaque nouvelle créature, Warrior's Blades s'équipe moins cher sur une créature chargée.
summary.en: Creatures entering and +1/+1 counters: Mabel, Valley Hero puts one on each new creature, and Warrior's Blades equips more cheaply to a creature with counters.

fr: Sous la moyenne du set.
Warrior's Blades, joué dans la majorité des decks, servait aussi de burn.
Teyo, Lightshield Expert et Kiora of Fire and Ashes figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: Below the set average.
Warrior's Blades, in most of its decks, doubled as burn.
Teyo, Lightshield Expert and Kiora of Fire and Ashes were among its best-performing cards.

summary.fr: Créatures qui meurent : Edgar, Ancient Bloodlord sacrifie et gagne de la vie à chaque mort, Blessed Ghoul revient du cimetière, Twisted Fates détruit et renforce.
summary.en: Creatures that die: Edgar, Ancient Bloodlord sacrifices and gains life with each death, Blessed Ghoul returns from the graveyard, and Twisted Fates destroys and pumps.

fr: Sous la moyenne du set.
Twisted Fates, joué dans la majorité des decks, était son removal le plus fiable.
Fatehold Chronologist et Generous Revival figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: Below the set average.
Twisted Fates, in most of its decks, was its most reliable removal.
Fatehold Chronologist and Generous Revival were among its best-performing cards.

summary.fr: Le Jace token et les capacités de loyauté : Kiora of Salt and Sand récompense leur activation, Mind Meanderer se bat à l'arrivée, Arcane Amphisbaena et Tam's Resistance renforcent Jace.
summary.en: The Jace token and loyalty abilities: Kiora of Salt and Sand rewards activating them, Mind Meanderer fights on arrival, and Arcane Amphisbaena and Tam's Resistance empower Jace.

fr: Le plus faible taux de victoire du set.
Mind Meanderer, sa carte la plus jouée, était aussi sa principale source de removal.
Countersculpt et Twinned Vision figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: The lowest win rate of the set.
Mind Meanderer, its most-played card, was also its main source of removal.
Countersculpt and Twinned Vision were among its best-performing cards.
